title: State transition encoding
statement: For a Boolean list $D$, define its next-step encoding as follows. If its encoded word is done, retain $D$. Otherwise, if the validity condition holds for the lengths of its two encoded lists and its encoded word, form the pair encoding of its context with the pair encoding of the remaining word, the updated index list, and the concatenation of its list representation with the encoding of its value. If that validity condition fails, pair its context with the encoding of an empty word, the unchanged index list, and the unchanged list representation.
caveat: The state projections, validity condition, and encoding operations are not defined in the supplied material.
